verdict: Paid campaigns are paused; organic presence is holding but softening.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, paid advertising on Meta and Google has been fully paused, meaning no spend went out and no paid leads came in. Your Google Business Profile carried all activity this period — 47 total actions including 25 direction requests, 21 website clicks, and 1 call — but that engagement dropped sharply in the last 7 days and has stayed low through this week. Website sessions also slipped 16% week-over-week, a modest but consistent decline with no paid traffic to cushion it. Reactivating paid campaigns is the immediate priority to restore lead flow and arrest the organic softening.
